requirement_summary: DCI formats 0_0 and 1_0 shall use bandwidth-dependent frequency-assignment bit widths and a common payload size after 0_0 padding.
Contiguous PRB allocations carried by DCI shall use resource-indication value encoding and decoding rather than private bit packing.
Strict PDCCH validation shall use waveform generation, DMRS-aided channel estimation, equalization, nrPDCCHDecode, and RNTI-masked nrDCIDecode evidence.
PDCCH DCI validation shall not fabricate transport-block size because TBS is a downstream allocation calculation, not a decoded DCI field.
